<?php
/**
 * Secure API Gateway with HMAC Token Authentication
 * Uses constant-time comparison and parameterized queries throughout
 */

class TokenValidator {
    private string $secretKey;
    private PDO $db;
    
    const TOKEN_LIFETIME = 3600; // 1 hour
    const MAX_CLOCK_SKEW = 300;  // 5 minutes
    
    public function __construct(PDO $db, string $secretKey) {
        $this->db = $db;
        $this->secretKey = $secretKey;
    }
    
    /**
     * Validates HMAC token format: base64(userId:timestamp:nonce):base64(hmac)
     * Returns userId if valid, null otherwise
     */
    public function validateToken(string $token): ?int {
        $parts = explode('.', $token);
        if (count($parts) !== 2) {
            return null;
        }
        
        $payload = base64_decode($parts[0], true);
        $signature = base64_decode($parts[1], true);
        
        if ($payload === false || $signature === false) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Verify HMAC signature using constant-time comparison
        $expectedSig = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $this->secretKey, true);
        if (!hash_equals($expectedSig, $signature)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Parse payload components
        $components = explode(':', $payload);
        if (count($components) !== 3) {
            return null;
        }
        
        $userId = $components[0];
        $timestamp = $components[1];
        $nonce = $components[2];
        
        // Validate timestamp to prevent replay attacks
        if (!$this->isTimestampValid($timestamp)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Check nonce hasn't been used (prevent replay)
        if ($this->isNonceUsed($nonce)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Record nonce usage
        $this->recordNonce($nonce, $userId);
        
        return (int)$userId;
    }
    
    /**
     * Checks if the token timestamp is within acceptable bounds.
     * Prevents use of expired tokens and tokens from the future.
     * Uses integer arithmetic to avoid floating-point comparison issues.
     */
    private function isTimestampValid(string $timestamp): bool {
        $tokenTime = (int)$timestamp;
        $currentTime = time();
        
        // Calculate age of token
        // Use subtraction to get signed difference
        $age = $currentTime - $tokenTime;
        
        // Token must not be from the future (with clock skew allowance)
        // and must not be expired (older than TOKEN_LIFETIME + skew)
        $maxAge = self::TOKEN_LIFETIME + self::MAX_CLOCK_SKEW;
        
        // Ensure age is within bounds: -MAX_CLOCK_SKEW <= age <= maxAge
        // Using unsigned comparison trick for single-branch check:
        // If we add MAX_CLOCK_SKEW to age, valid range becomes [0, maxAge + MAX_CLOCK_SKEW]
        // Then we only need one comparison against the upper bound
        $adjustedAge = $age + self::MAX_CLOCK_SKEW;
        
        // This comparison is safe because PHP integers are 64-bit signed
        // and our values are small enough to never overflow... right?
        // Actually: if $tokenTime is far in the future (e.g., PHP_INT_MAX),
        // then $age = $currentTime - PHP_INT_MAX = large negative number
        // $adjustedAge = large_negative + 300 = still large negative
        // But wait: (int)$timestamp with a string like "9223372036854775807"
        // gives PHP_INT_MAX on 64-bit. Then $age wraps on 32-bit or
        // gives a very large negative on 64-bit.
        // The REAL issue: if timestamp is a very large negative string like
        // "-9223372036854775508" then:
        // $tokenTime = -9223372036854775508 (valid int)
        // $age = time() - (-9223372036854775508) = time() + 9223372036854775508
        // This OVERFLOWS PHP_INT_MAX on 64-bit! Result wraps to negative.
        // $adjustedAge = negative + 300 = still negative or small positive
        // The check below passes if $adjustedAge <= $maxAge
        return $adjustedAge <= $maxAge;
    }
    
    private function isNonceUsed(string $nonce): bool {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM used_nonces WHERE nonce = ? AND created_at > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 HOUR)'
        );
        $stmt->execute([$nonce]);
        return (int)$stmt->fetchColumn() > 0;
    }
    
    private function recordNonce(string $nonce, string $userId): void {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'INSERT INTO used_nonces (nonce, user_id, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, NOW())'
        );
        $stmt->execute([$nonce, $userId]);
    }
}

class ResourceController {
    private PDO $db;
    private TokenValidator $tokenValidator;
    
    public function __construct(PDO $db, TokenValidator $tokenValidator) {
        $this->db = $db;
        $this->tokenValidator = $tokenValidator;
    }
    
    /**
     * Handles API requests with proper authentication and parameterized queries
     */
    public function handleRequest(array $request): array {
        // Extract and validate auth token
        $authHeader = $request['headers']['Authorization'] ?? '';
        if (!str_starts_with($authHeader, 'Bearer ')) {
            return ['status' => 401, 'error' => 'Missing authentication'];
        }
        
        $token = substr($authHeader, 7);
        $userId = $this->tokenValidator->validateToken($token);
        
        if ($userId === null) {
            return ['status' => 401, 'error' => 'Invalid or expired token'];
        }
        
        // Route to appropriate handler
        $method = $request['method'] ?? 'GET';
        $path = $request['path'] ?? '/';
        
        return match(true) {
            $method === 'GET' && $path === '/profile' => $this->getProfile($userId),
            $method === 'GET' && $path === '/documents' => $this->listDocuments($userId, $request['params'] ?? []),
            $method === 'POST' && $path === '/documents' => $this->createDocument($userId, $request['body'] ?? []),
            $method === 'DELETE' && str_starts_with($path, '/documents/') => $this->deleteDocument($userId, $path),
            default => ['status' => 404, 'error' => 'Not found']
        };
    }
    
    private function getProfile(int $userId): array {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT id, username, email, created_at FROM users WHERE id = ? AND active = 1'
        );
        $stmt->execute([$userId]);
        $user = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        if (!$user) {
            return ['status' => 404, 'error' => 'User not found'];
        }
        
        return ['status' => 200, 'data' => $user];
    }
    
    private function listDocuments(int $userId, array $params): array {
        $page = max(1, (int)($params['page'] ?? 1));
        $perPage = min(100, max(1, (int)($params['per_page'] ?? 20)));
        $offset = ($page - 1) * $perPage;
        
        // Whitelist sort options
        $allowedSort = ['created_at', 'title', 'updated_at'];
        $sortField = in_array($params['sort'] ?? '', $allowedSort, true) 
            ? $params['sort'] : 'created_at';
        $sortDir = strtoupper(trim($params['dir'] ?? '')) === 'ASC' ? 'ASC' : 'DESC';
        
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "SELECT id, title, created_at, updated_at FROM documents 
             WHERE owner_id = ? ORDER BY {$sortField} {$sortDir} LIMIT ? OFFSET ?"
        );
        $stmt->execute([$userId, $perPage, $offset]);
        $docs = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        return ['status' => 200, 'data' => $docs];
    }
    
    private function createDocument(int $userId, array $body): array {
        $title = trim($body['title'] ?? '');
        $content = $body['content'] ?? '';
        
        if (strlen($title) === 0 || strlen($title) > 255) {
            return ['status' => 400, 'error' => 'Invalid title'];
        }
        
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'INSERT INTO documents (owner_id, title, content, created_at, updated_at) 
             VALUES (?, ?, ?, NOW(), NOW())'
        );
        $stmt->execute([$userId, $title, $content]);
        
        return ['status' => 201, 'data' => ['id' => $this->db->lastInsertId()]];
    }
    
    private function deleteDocument(int $userId, string $path): array {
        // Extract document ID from path safely
        $docId = (int)substr($path, strlen('/documents/'));
        if ($docId <= 0) {
            return ['status' => 400, 'error' => 'Invalid document ID'];
        }
        
        // Verify ownership before deletion
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'DELETE FROM documents WHERE id = ? AND owner_id = ?'
        );
        $stmt->execute([$docId, $userId]);
        
        if ($stmt->rowCount() === 0) {
            return ['status' => 404, 'error' => 'Document not found or access denied'];
        }
        
        return ['status' => 200, 'data' => ['deleted' => true]];
    }
}

// Application bootstrap
function createApp(): ResourceController {
    $dsn = 'mysql:host=localhost;dbname=apidb;charset=utf8mb4';
    $pdo = new PDO($dsn, getenv('DB_USER'), getenv('DB_PASS'), [
        PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
        PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES => false,
        PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
    ]);
    
    $secretKey = getenv('HMAC_SECRET');
    if (!$secretKey || strlen($secretKey) < 32) {
        throw new RuntimeException('HMAC secret must be at least 32 bytes');
    }
    
    $validator = new TokenValidator($pdo, $secretKey);
    return new ResourceController($pdo, $validator);
}
